title: A member linked to the app whose number no longer matches gets neither the app message nor a WhatsApp
what: When the owner sends a group message by asking the assistant, a member counts as 'has the app' if the record is linked to the app OR the mobile number matches an app member. But the app message is only sent to app members found by matching the mobile number. A linked member whose number was changed on the record, or whose app account has no number, is left off the WhatsApp list (they 'have the app') and also left out of the app send (no number match). They get nothing and the card does not say so. If every member of the group is like this, the card says 'Send it on WhatsApp below' with no WhatsApp button under it.
expected: Every member of the group is either sent the app message or put on the WhatsApp list, and the card counts add up to the group.
who: members whose app link and mobile number disagree, and their owner
how_often: each group message that includes such a member
fix_line: Use the same rule for 'has the app' and for who gets the app message, and send anyone not matched to the WhatsApp list

title: The assistant says a message was sent to N in the app, with no way to see who will not get a pop-up
what: The message card says how many members have the app and, after sending, 'Sent to N in the app'. Whether each of them sees a pop-up depends on their phone: the 'Messages from my gym' switch, phone notifications being allowed, and a background check about every 15 minutes that some phone makers stop. None of this is known to the admin app, and there is no per-member list of who got or opened it; the Messages page shows only a total 'Seen by X of N'.
expected: The owner can see, member by member, who has the app with gym messages turned on, and who has opened the message.
how_often: every message sent from the assistant
fix_line: Show per member whether the message was opened, and say on the card that pop-ups depend on the member's phone settings
